impact:
The suite fault-injects authority loss on some mutation paths but not all. Unobserved: ensureDir's per-mutation gates (store.ts:503/505 for mkdir and chmod — the pair that keeps a lock-losing writer from re-creating directories under its successor) and collectGarbage's pin-unlink gate (store.ts:950), where only the generation-unlink gate at store.ts:971 has a test that observes it stopping the sweep.

Both are the same discipline the module's header claims: "assertHeld() immediately precedes EVERY mutation... pinned by a test". Currently pinned for most, not every.
title: [T-010] Two authority gates are never fault-injected: ensureDir's mkdir/chmod and GC's pin unlink
